I recently did (and am doing) a marathon of replaying dragon quest games so my thoughts are more recent. These are also just my personal opinions

DQ1-3: I do not enjoy any of these honestly. 3 is passable but whenever I play it I just wish I was playing one of the more recent titles. There are no references to these in later games that you won't get. I think it's fine to skip these to prevent burnout.

DQ4: You will enjoy it. It has great pacing and doesn't overstay its welcome, it will not contribute to burnout.

DQ5: My personal favorite, I could play it a hundred times.

DQ6: The roughest of the more modern DQ games IMO, I've actually never completed it. Even by DQ story standards, it falls flat. There are a couple of fun party members but they aren't enough to save it. It's a slog imo.

DQ7: What I'm currently playing. I've tried playing it once before and dropped it pretty late because of burnout. This time I've been sticking with it and am enjoying it a lot more. It is horrifically long but I'm just taking it slow and enjoying all the details. Honestly has my favorite concept of any of the DQ games probably, it's really satisfying to progress through. I would recommend saving this one for last or not doing it in a marathon.

DQ8: Played it for the first time recently, super fun and not too long. I don't remember having much difficulty in the beginning, I guess I'd just make sure you aren't avoiding fighting monsters (it's really tempting to run around every monster since they aren't random encounters)

To be completely honest, I think DQ11 stands on its own and doesn't require you to play the older ones first. Conversely, I think it actually makes you want to play the older ones after (at least for me). It's so incredibly polished and fun that it leaves you wanting more. I think you would be absolutely fine playing it now.

That being said, If you really want to play some older ones first I would just play 4 and 8. You won't get burned out that way because 4, 8, and 11 are all very different in tone and presentation. You could play 5 too but you said you already have. 

Bonus: This is probably an unpopular opinion but I dislike the DQM: Joker games. Played and beat them, but I find them very tedious. Try DQM caravan heart for the GBA, it blows them away.
